title: Ship and document the qualified real-time SDK and Gallery profile
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Package the already-qualified candidate and document the user-facing fixed-step, interpolation, slow-motion and accuracy tradeoffs without silently changing its equations or defaults. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Installed SDK and Gallery tests demonstrate explicit profile/version selection and capability behavior, including unsupported requests and clear rejection of incompatible old clients. Keeping a legacy solver available is optional, not an exit requirement.
Publish exact device/workload quality and performance limits, remaining unsupported modes and honest default-selection behavior; legacy evidence is not relabeled.
Verify relocatable packages and runtime artifact hashes against the frozen candidate; any material kernel/schedule/profile change triggers candidate refresh and affected requalification.
Show 30/60/high-refresh presentation behavior and bounded long-running memory/resource ownership through public clients.
